connectors.name: Fooocus-API: Upscale / Vary
connectors.description: Attach ONE image. Vary: the message can describe the image (optional).
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: Fooocus-API: Image Prompt / FaceSwap
connectors.description: Attach 1 or 2 reference images and write a prompt.
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: Fooocus-API: Outpaint
connectors.description: Attach ONE image. The message (optional) describes the new area.
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: Fooocus-API: Inpaint
connectors.description: Attach TWO images: first the original, second the mask (same size; WHITE = area to change, BLACK = keep). The message describes what should appear.
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: Fooocus-API: Describe image
connectors.description: Attach ONE image; the reply is a text description (a prompt you can reuse).
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: Ollama (API بومی، چت)
connectors.description: Ollama native chat API (http://localhost:11434). Install Ollama and pull a model first.
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: چت با نمایش تفکر مدل (سبک DeepSeek)
connectors.description: Chat API that streams a reasoning field (reasoning_content); the model's thinking is shown as a quoted block. Needs an API key.
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: OpenAI Images (تصویر)
connectors.description: OpenAI image generation. Needs an OpenAI API key.
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: OpenAI Text-to-Speech (صوت)
connectors.description: Text to speech with OpenAI. Needs an OpenAI API key; the reply is an audio file you can play.
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: AUTOMATIC1111 / Forge (تصویر)
connectors.description: Local Stable Diffusion WebUI (start it with the --api option). Models are read from the server.
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: ComfyUI (تصویر، گردش‌کار پیش‌فرض)
connectors.description: Local ComfyUI, default text-to-image workflow. Use the port ComfyUI listens on (8188 or 8000).
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: ComfyUI: Wan 2.2 (ویدیو)
connectors.description: Local ComfyUI, Wan 2.2 5B text-to-video. The model box is the diffusion model file; needs several minutes on a mid-range GPU. Use the port ComfyUI listens on.
connectors.author: AiChat

connectors.name: کار ناهمزمان عمومی (ویدیو / سه‌بعدی)
connectors.description: Edit the paths and field names to match your service. Submit a job, poll its status, then download the file.
connectors.author: AiChat
